metadata.description: Plugins for using third-party coding/review CLIs from inside Claude Code. Ships the opencode and codex plugins.

plugins.name: opencode
plugins.description: Use opencode from Claude Code to review code with whichever LLM you have configured. See plugins/opencode/README.md for the full feature list and CHANGELOG for what's new in each release.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Use codex from Claude Code for code review and write-capable task delegation. Full v0.5.1 parity with the opencode plugin; replaces the third-party openai-codex plugin's /codex:* namespace. See plugins/codex/README.md.
